title: Recover an AGV “BUMP” fault (Exception Codes 21057/21060) using RMS
summary: When RMS shows an AGV “Bump” fault with Exception Code 21057 or 21060, stop RMS, remove the obstruction that caused the bump/obstacle trigger, hold the AGV RESET button for two seconds to clear the fault, press E-stop again, then resume RMS. Verify the Exception Code is cleared on the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen before resuming normal operation.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when the RMS interface displays an AGV “Bump” fault and the Exception Code shown is 21057 or 21060, indicating a collision bar trigger or obstacle-avoidance trigger that requires RMS-side fault recovery.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for physical obstruction removal when the bump/obstacle trigger is caused by an on-grid obstruction; the obstruction must be physically cleared before attempting RESET.
Do not proceed to resume RMS if the Exception Code remains after the two-second AGV RESET attempt.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute RMS-side recovery actions (E-stop RMS, use AGV RESET for two seconds, press E-stop again, resume RMS) and verify the Exception Code is cleared on the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen.
safety_notes: This procedure includes E-stopping RMS (not physical E-stop).
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to remove the obstruction on the grid

system_preconditions: RMS is displaying the AGV “Bump” Fault Screen (Figure 5-2) with an Exception Code field.

visual_references.description: RMS “Bump” Fault Screen showing Exception Code values 21057 and 21060 and the AGV RESET button.

steps.title: Open the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen
steps.purpose: Locate the displayed Exception Code and the AGV RESET control required for bump fault recovery.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) and navigate to the AGV “Bump” Fault Screen (Figure 5-2).
steps.expected_result: The RMS “Bump” Fault Screen is visible with an Exception Code field and the AGV RESET button.
steps.healthy_condition: Exception Code field is populated with a bump-related code (21057 or 21060) and the AGV RESET button is available on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS “Bump” Fault Screen is not showing an Exception Code, or the screen cannot be reached/loaded.

actions.label: Navigate to Bump Fault Screen
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the AGV “Bump” Fault Screen (Figure 5-2).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 5-2: AGV “Bump” Fault Screen; recovery steps reference E-stop RMS, remove obstruction, click AGV RESET for two (2) seconds, press E-stop again, and resume RMS.

steps.title: Confirm the Exception Code is 21057 or 21060
steps.purpose: Ensure the fault matches the documented “BUMP” recovery scenario before performing RESET and resuming RMS.
steps.instruction: On the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen, confirm the displayed Exception Code is one of the following: 21057 or 21060.
steps.expected_result: Exception Code is either 21057 (Robot front collision bar triggers) or 21060 (The robot triggers the obstacle avoidance).
steps.healthy_condition: Exception Code matches 21057 or 21060 as shown on the screen.

actions.label: Check Exception Code
actions.exact_action: Confirm the displayed Exception Code is one of the documented Bump fault codes: 21057 or 21060.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Exception Code is not 21057 or 21060, do not continue with this bump-fault recovery procedure.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Table 5-1: AGV Exception Codes — 21057 Robot front collision bar triggers; 21060 The robot triggers the obstacle avoidance.

steps.title: E-stop RMS
steps.purpose: Put RMS into a stopped state before clearing the bump fault.
steps.instruction: On the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen / RMS UI, E-stop RMS.
steps.expected_result: RMS is in an E-stopped state as indicated by the RMS E-stop control/button state on the UI.
steps.healthy_condition: E-stop state is active on the RMS UI.
steps.failure_condition: RMS does not enter an E-stopped state (E-stop control/button state does not reflect the stop).
stop_or_escalate_if: If RMS does not reflect an E-stopped state, do not proceed to obstruction removal/RESET.

steps.title: Remove the obstruction that caused the bump/obstacle trigger
steps.purpose: Eliminate the physical cause of the bump fault so the AGV can clear the fault and resume operation.
steps.instruction: Physically clear the obstruction on the grid that caused the bump/collision/obstacle trigger.
steps.expected_result: The physical obstruction is removed from the AGV path/area that triggered the bump/obstacle avoidance event.
steps.healthy_condition: No remaining obstruction is present in the area that caused the bump/obstacle trigger.
steps.failure_condition: The obstruction remains in place or cannot be safely removed.

actions.label: Clear obstruction
actions.exact_action: Remove the obstruction that caused the bump/collision/obstacle trigger (physically clear the obstruction).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the obstruction cannot be removed, do not proceed to AGV RESET and resuming RMS.

steps.title: Hold AGV RESET for two seconds to clear the fault
steps.purpose: Clear the bump fault on the AGV by using the RMS AGV RESET control for the required duration.
steps.instruction: On the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen, click/press the AGV RESET button and hold it for two (2) seconds.
steps.expected_result: The AGV bump fault clears after the two-second hold, reflected by the RMS fault/exception display updating.
steps.healthy_condition: After the two-second hold, the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen no longer shows the bump Exception Code (21057/21060) for the faulted AGV.
steps.failure_condition: The Exception Code 21057/21060 remains displayed after the two-second AGV RESET attempt.

actions.label: Hold AGV RESET 2 seconds
actions.exact_action: Click the AGV RESET button for two (2) seconds to clear the fault.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Exception Code 21057/21060 remains after the two-second AGV RESET, stop and escalate for further fault recovery steps; do not proceed to resume operation if the fault persists.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Recovery steps: 3. Click the AGV RESET button for two (2) seconds to clear the fault.

steps.title: Press E-stop again
steps.purpose: Follow the documented recovery sequence after issuing AGV RESET.
steps.instruction: Press E-stop again on the RMS UI.
steps.expected_result: RMS reflects the E-stop state again after the second E-stop press.
steps.healthy_condition: E-stop state is active on the RMS UI.
steps.failure_condition: RMS does not reflect the E-stop state after the second press.

steps.title: Resume RMS
steps.purpose: Return RMS to normal operation after the fault is cleared.
steps.instruction: Resume RMS (return RMS to normal operation) using the RMS controls on the same RMS UI.
steps.expected_result: RMS resumes normal operation after the resume action is taken.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS is no longer in the E-stopped state and the faulted AGV is no longer showing the bump Exception Code on the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen.
steps.failure_condition: RMS resumes but the bump Exception Code remains displayed on the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the bump Exception Code remains displayed, stop and escalate; do not continue normal operation with the fault still active.

steps.title: Verify the bump fault is cleared on the RMS interface
steps.purpose: Confirm the recovery succeeded before leaving the AGV in service.
steps.instruction: Verify on the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen that the AGV no longer shows the bump fault/exception code (21057/21060).
steps.expected_result: The RMS “Bump” Fault Screen no longer displays Exception Code 21057 or 21060 for the faulted AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: Exception Code is cleared (not shown) and the bump fault is no longer active on the RMS interface.
steps.failure_condition: Exception Code 21057 or 21060 remains visible after resuming RMS.

actions.label: Check fault cleared
actions.exact_action: Verify the Bump fault is cleared on the RMS interface (the AGV no longer shows the Bump fault/exception code on the Bump Fault Screen).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Exception Code remains, stop and escalate for further fault recovery steps.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected result and recovery sequence require clearing the fault by holding AGV RESET for two seconds and verifying the bump fault/exception code is cleared before resuming RMS.

success_criteria: On the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen, the Exception Code 21057 or 21060 is cleared after holding AGV RESET for two seconds.
After resuming RMS, the RMS interface no longer shows the bump fault/exception code for the faulted AGV.
healthy_conditions: RMS “Bump” Fault Screen no longer displays Exception Code 21057 or 21060 for the faulted AGV.
RMS is resumed to normal operation (not E-stopped) after the fault is cleared.
failure_conditions: Exception Code 21057 or 21060 remains displayed after the two-second AGV RESET attempt.
RMS resumes but the bump fault/exception code remains active on the RMS “Bump” Fault Screen.
escalation_guidance: If the Exception Code 21057/21060 remains after the two-second AGV RESET, stop and escalate for further fault recovery steps; do not proceed to resume operation if the fault persists.
